skillTree.name: Treeconomy
skillTree.description: A complete gamified progression system for building excellent credit from zero to hero

progressionTiers.name: Novice Credit Builder
progressionTiers.description: Starting your credit journey - learning the basics and establishing your first accounts

progressionTiers.name: Apprentice Credit Manager
progressionTiers.description: Building positive habits and expanding your credit profile responsibly

progressionTiers.name: Skilled Credit Strategist
progressionTiers.description: Optimizing your credit usage and strategically managing multiple accounts

progressionTiers.name: Expert Credit Architect
progressionTiers.description: Fine-tuning every aspect of your credit profile for maximum impact

progressionTiers.name: Master Credit Virtuoso
progressionTiers.description: Achieving and maintaining elite credit status with perfect execution

skillPaths.description: Master the art of on-time payments - the single most important factor in credit scoring
Learn to manage credit utilization like a pro - keeping balances low relative to limits
Build a long, stable credit history through strategic account management
skillPaths.primaryImpact: Length of Credit History (15% of score)

skillPaths.description: Diversify your credit portfolio with different types of accounts
Minimize credit inquiries and new account impacts through smart applications
Protect your credit by identifying and disputing errors on your reports

skills.name: First Payment Success
skills.description: Make your very first on-time payment on any credit account
tasks: Set up a secured credit card or become authorized user
Pay the bill in full by the due date
skills.tips: Set up automatic payments or calendar reminders to never miss a due date

skills.name: Payment Streak: 3 Months
skills.description: Successfully make 3 consecutive on-time payments
skills.tips: Consistency is key - even small payments build trust with lenders

skills.name: Payment Streak: 6 Months
skills.description: Achieve 6 months of perfect payment history
skills.tips: After 6 months, you're building real credibility with credit bureaus

skills.name: Payment Streak: 12 Months
skills.description: Complete one full year of on-time payments
tasks: Consider applying for an unsecured card upgrade
skills.tips: One year of perfect payments significantly boosts your creditworthiness

skills.name: Payment Streak: 24 Months
skills.description: Achieve 2 years of flawless payment history
tasks: Manage multiple accounts with 100% on-time rate
Build emergency fund to protect payment streak
skills.tips: 2 years establishes you as a reliable borrower in lenders' eyes

skills.name: Payment Streak: 4+ Years
skills.description: Maintain 4 years of perfect payment history across all accounts
tasks: Never miss a payment for 48+ months
Build systems to prevent payment failures
skills.tips: At this level, payment history is your strongest asset

skills.name: Payment Streak: 7+ Years
skills.description: Achieve legendary status with 7+ years of perfect payments
skills.tips: You've mastered the most important credit factor - maintain forever!

skills.name: Understand Utilization
skills.description: Learn what credit utilization is and why it matters
tasks: Understand that lower is better (ideally under 30%)
skills.tips: Utilization is calculated both per-card and overall across all cards

skills.name: Under 50% Utilization
skills.description: Reduce credit utilization to below 50% on all cards
tasks: Calculate current utilization on each card
Pay down balances to below 50% of limits
skills.tips: Even getting under 50% shows improvement to credit bureaus

skills.name: Under 30% Utilization
skills.description: Achieve the recommended 30% utilization threshold
tasks: Pay down all cards to under 30% of limit
Set up balance alerts at 25% threshold
Keep spending in check to maintain ratio
skills.tips: 30% is the magic number where score benefits become significant

skills.name: Under 10% Utilization
skills.description: Reach elite utilization levels under 10%
tasks: Reduce all balances to under 10% of limits
Pay off cards multiple times per month if needed
skills.tips: Under 10% is where high credit scores thrive - shows minimal credit dependency

skills.name: Under 5% Utilization
skills.description: Achieve ultra-low utilization for maximum score benefit
tasks: Pay balances before statement closing dates
skills.tips: Pay before statement closes to report lower balances to bureaus

skills.name: Zero Balance Reported (Except One)
skills.description: Master the AZEO strategy: All Zero Except One card reporting small balance
tasks: Pay all cards to zero before statement dates
skills.tips: AZEO (All Zero Except One) maximizes utilization scoring algorithm

skills.name: Perfect Utilization Mastery
skills.description: Maintain perfect utilization management indefinitely with high limits
tasks: Optimize statement timing across all cards
skills.tips: With high limits and low usage, utilization becomes effortless

skills.name: First Account Opened
skills.description: Open your first credit account - the beginning of your credit age
tasks: Open secured card or become authorized user
Understand this starts your credit age clock
skills.tips: Your oldest account is precious - never close it unless absolutely necessary

skills.name: 6 Months Credit History
skills.description: Reach the minimum credit history age for scoring
tasks: Wait 6 months from first account opening
Keep account active and in good standing
skills.tips: 6 months is when you cross the threshold for a real credit score

skills.name: 1 Year Credit History
skills.description: Celebrate your first year of credit history
tasks: Keep oldest account open and active
Use account occasionally to prevent closure
skills.tips: Make a small purchase on your oldest card every few months to keep it active

skills.name: 2 Year Credit History
skills.description: Build to 2 years of credit age - entering experienced territory
skills.tips: Every new account lowers your average age - space applications strategically

skills.name: 5 Year Credit History
skills.description: Achieve 5 years average credit age - strong historical foundation
skills.tips: At 5 years, you're in the 'good' category for credit history length

skills.name: 10 Year Credit History
skills.description: Reach a decade of credit history - veteran status
tasks: Oldest account should be 10+ years old
Help younger friends start their credit journey
skills.tips: 10+ years is excellent - you're now a credit veteran

skills.name: 15+ Year Credit History
skills.description: Achieve elite credit age with 15+ years of history
tasks: Pass down wisdom to next generation
skills.tips: Add children as authorized users to give them a head start on credit age

skills.name: Single Account Type
skills.description: Understand you're starting with just one type of credit
tasks: Identify your current credit type (likely credit card)
Learn about installment vs revolving credit
skills.tips: Don't rush to diversify - only add accounts you actually need

skills.name: Two Account Types
skills.description: Add a second type of credit to your profile
tasks: Add either: auto loan, personal loan, or student loan
Keep existing credit card in good standing
skills.tips: Credit builder loans are great low-risk options for adding installment credit

skills.name: Diversified Portfolio
skills.description: Build a well-rounded credit mix with 3+ account types
tasks: Have at least 3 different credit types
Examples: credit card + auto loan + mortgage
Or: credit card + personal loan + retail card
skills.tips: Quality over quantity - only take credit you need and can manage

skills.name: Premium Mix Achievement
skills.description: Achieve ideal credit mix with mortgage + revolving + installment
tasks: Maintain mortgage or large installment loan
Possibly add retail card if beneficial
skills.tips: This mix shows lenders you can handle diverse credit responsibilities

skills.name: Elite Credit Portfolio
skills.description: Maintain perfect credit mix with aged, diverse accounts
skills.tips: At this level, focus on maintaining what you have, not adding more

skills.name: Understand Hard Inquiries
skills.description: Learn the difference between hard and soft inquiries
tasks: Learn that hard inquiries lower score temporarily
Understand soft inquiries don't affect score
Know inquiries stay on report for 2 years
skills.tips: Hard inquiries impact score for ~12 months, fall off after 24 months

skills.name: Minimize New Applications
skills.description: Limit credit applications to only necessary accounts
tasks: Avoid retail store card offers unless strategic
skills.tips: Use pre-qualification tools to check approval odds without hard pull

skills.name: Strategic Application Timing
skills.description: Master the art of timing credit applications for minimal impact
tasks: Use 30-45 day shopping windows for same loan type
Space different credit types by 6+ months
skills.tips: Multiple auto/mortgage inquiries in 30-45 days count as one inquiry

skills.name: Zero New Accounts (12 months)
skills.description: Go 12 months without opening any new credit accounts
tasks: Resist temptation of new credit offers
skills.tips: Letting your profile mature without new accounts boosts all age-related metrics

skills.name: Zero Inquiries (24 months)
skills.description: Achieve 24 months with zero hard inquiries on your report
tasks: Maintain current accounts without applying for new ones
All old inquiries aged off report
skills.tips: Clean inquiry report signals you're not desperate for credit

skills.name: Inquiry Immunity
skills.description: Master inquiry management - only apply when strategically optimal
tasks: Apply only when score is high enough for best rates
skills.tips: With excellent credit, you can be selective about when/where you apply

skills.name: First Credit Report Pull
skills.description: Access and review your credit report from all three bureaus
tasks: Review reports from Equifax, Experian, TransUnion
Identify any errors or unfamiliar accounts
skills.tips: You're entitled to one free report per bureau per year

skills.name: First Successful Dispute
skills.description: Successfully dispute and remove an error from your credit report
skills.tips: Common errors: wrong balances, accounts not yours, incorrect late payments

skills.name: Clean Report Achievement
skills.description: Achieve a credit report with zero errors or negative items
tasks: Pay off and wait for charge-offs to age (if applicable)
skills.tips: Some items can't be removed if accurate, but you can add explanatory notes

skills.name: Monitoring Mastery
skills.description: Set up comprehensive credit monitoring across all bureaus
tasks: Set up monitoring with major bureaus
Catch and dispute errors within 30 days
skills.tips: Quick response to errors prevents them from affecting your score long-term

skills.name: Identity Protection Pro
skills.description: Implement advanced identity theft protection strategies
tasks: Consider credit freeze or fraud alerts
Use strong unique passwords for financial accounts
Monitor dark web for leaked credentials
skills.tips: Prevention is easier than fixing identity theft damage

skills.name: Perfect Report Maintenance
skills.description: Maintain absolutely perfect credit reports across all bureaus for years

rewards.achievement: Elite Report Defense - Perfect Credit Profile

tasks: Zero negative items across all bureaus
Help others learn credit report reading
skills.tips: You've mastered credit defense - now help others protect their credit

skills.name: Multiple Account On-Time Mastery
skills.description: Successfully manage on-time payments across 3+ credit accounts
tasks: Never miss a single payment across any account
skills.tips: Use a payment calendar or app to track multiple due dates

skills.name: Credit Limit Increase Strategy
skills.description: Successfully request and receive credit limit increases to improve utilization
tasks: Request credit limit increases on existing cards
Lower utilization ratio without changing spending
skills.tips: Request increases every 6-12 months; many issuers offer automatic increases

skills.name: Authorized User Advantage
skills.description: Get added as authorized user on a well-aged account or add someone to yours
tasks: Become AU on parent/spouse's old account, OR
Add trusted person to your aged account
Ensure primary account has perfect payment history
skills.tips: Authorized user status can instantly add years to your credit age

skills.name: Credit Builder Loan
skills.description: Successfully complete a credit builder loan program
tasks: Open credit builder loan with bank/credit union
skills.tips: Credit builder loans report to all three bureaus and build savings too

skills.name: Statement Date Optimization
skills.description: Master the timing of payments relative to statement closing dates
tasks: Identify exact statement closing dates for all cards
Make payments 2-3 days before statement closes
Ensure low balances report to bureaus
skills.tips: What's reported to bureaus is your statement balance, not current balance

skills.name: Emergency Fund Buffer
skills.description: Build 3-6 month emergency fund to protect payment streak
tasks: Save 3-6 months of expenses in emergency fund
Keep fund separate from daily accounts
Ensures you can always make payments
skills.tips: Emergency fund is your insurance policy against payment disasters

skills.name: Pre-Approval Shopping
skills.description: Use pre-qualification tools to shop rates without hard inquiries
tasks: Use CardMatch, Credit Karma, issuer pre-qual tools
Only apply when confident of approval
skills.tips: Pre-qualification is your friend - always check before applying

skills.name: Goodwill Letter Success
skills.description: Successfully request goodwill adjustment for late payment removal
tasks: Identify legitimate late payment from good customer history
Write professional goodwill letter to creditor
Achieve late payment removal as courtesy
skills.tips: Goodwill letters work best if you have otherwise perfect history and valid reason

skills.name: Retail Card Strategic Use
skills.description: Add retail credit card strategically for mix without overspending
tasks: Choose retail card from store you already shop at
Benefit from rewards + credit mix boost
skills.tips: Retail cards often have lower approval requirements and improve credit mix

skills.name: Never Close Old Accounts
skills.description: Maintain your oldest accounts active indefinitely
tasks: Keep oldest card(s) active with small recurring charges
Set up autopay for these charges
Never close accounts over 5 years old
Sock drawer cards if needed but keep them alive
skills.tips: A Netflix subscription on your oldest card keeps it active automatically

beginner: Start with a secured credit card if you have no credit history
Set up autopay for at least the minimum payment - never miss a due date
Keep your first credit card forever - it will become your oldest account
Use only 10-30% of your credit limit, even if you pay in full
Check your credit report for free at AnnualCreditReport.com
Don't apply for multiple credit cards in a short period
Become an authorized user on a parent/spouse's old account for instant history
intermediate: Pay before statement closing date to report lower balances
Request credit limit increases every 6-12 months to improve utilization
Use multiple cards for different spending categories to build diverse history
Set balance alerts at 25% of your credit limit
Dispute any errors on your credit report immediately
Consider a credit-builder loan to add installment credit to your mix
Space out credit applications by at least 6 months
advanced: Use AZEO (All Zero Except One) strategy for maximum utilization scoring
Time all payments to optimize statement balances across all cards
Keep oldest accounts active with small automated recurring charges
Use pre-qualification tools before applying to avoid unnecessary inquiries
Build 6+ months emergency fund to protect your payment streak
Add family members as authorized users to help their credit
Track credit score changes after each optimization to learn what works
expert: Maintain under 3% overall utilization with high credit limits
Coordinate statement dates across cards for optimal reporting
Use rapid rescore when timing matters (mortgage applications)
Freeze credit when not actively seeking new accounts
Consider business credit to separate from personal profile
Leverage credit card benefits to maximize value beyond just score building
Teach others about credit - sharing knowledge reinforces your mastery

notes_for_llm.understanding_progression: Users progress through 5 tiers from Novice (300-579 score) to Master (800-850 score). Each tier has specific skills across 6 paths that must be completed to advance.
notes_for_llm.skill_prerequisites: Skills use AND prerequisites. Every skill listed in a node's prerequisites array must be completed to unlock that node. This enables cross-path gating and multi-factor progression gates.
notes_for_llm.score_impact_explanation: The 'scoreImpact' field shows estimated point increases. These are cumulative - completing multiple skills compounds the effect. Actual impact varies by individual credit profile.
notes_for_llm.path_importance: The 6 paths correspond to the 5 FICO scoring factors plus dispute/defense: Payment History (35%), Utilization (30%), Credit Age (15%), Credit Mix (10%), New Credit (10%), and Report Defense (overall health).
notes_for_llm.gamification_mechanics: XP rewards, badges, achievements, daily/weekly/monthly quests, leaderboards, and milestones create engagement. Power-ups represent real credit-building strategies.
notes_for_llm.realistic_timelines: Credit building is a long game. Skills span from level 1 (immediate) to level 95+ (requiring 15+ years). This reflects reality - excellent credit cannot be rushed.
notes_for_llm.tier_transitions: Users can work on skills from higher tiers while still in lower tiers if prerequisites are met. The tier system is about credit score range, not strict level gating.
notes_for_llm.multiple_path_progression: Users should work on multiple paths simultaneously (e.g., making on-time payments while also managing utilization and building credit age). Real credit improvement requires multi-factor optimization.
notes_for_llm.quest_system: Daily/weekly/monthly quests reinforce good habits. They're repeatable and provide ongoing engagement beyond one-time skill completion.
notes_for_llm.achievement_variety: Achievements recognize different journeys: fast improvement (Speed Runner), perfection (Perfectionist), recovery from bad credit (Recovery Hero), and helping others (Community Leader).
notes_for_llm.llm_usage_tips: When explaining credit concepts to users, reference specific skills by ID and name. Use the tips sections for practical advice. Connect abstract goals ('improve my score') to concrete skill paths ('start with SKILL_001 in Payment Mastery path'). The skill tree provides structure for personalized credit improvement plans.
